title: Joost, Tommy Cash & Käärijä · I MISS US
description: The complete official music video: chrome studio microphones and crimson bokeh, starry Basel night and rainy Malmö street, cloudy Nordic lake, curved crimson grid boyband chamber, candlelit grand piano, pouring rain with clear umbrellas, 90s graffiti hip-hop alley and DJ turntables, folding-chair garage with teal muscle car, highway motorcycle sidecar, airport tarmac jet, and POP Times "Euroboys are back!" finale. Original music with three physical mouth-engine voices.
